interactions.dialogue: You know, sometimes I wonder if all this theoretical physics... if it truly makes a difference in the grand scheme of things.
I suppose it's one way to define existence, isn't it? To understand the 'why'.
Perhaps. But the 'why' can be a heavy burden. Especially when the answers only lead to more questions, more... responsibilities.

dialogue: Don't worry, we'll figure it out together.

interactions.dialogue: I appreciate your concern. It's just... the implications of some of our work. It makes you question everything.
That's why we have to be careful. To ensure whatever we uncover is used for good, not ill.
True. It's a heavy mantle to bear, the pursuit of knowledge. But... perhaps it's a worthwhile one after all.

dialogue: As long as we don't accidentally shatter spacetime again.
